subject: OHLCV startup backfill event-loop starvation — structural concern
description: runOhlcvStartupProbe() triggered a 5-hour OHLCV backfill at container startup (1599 rows, iterative HTTP calls). This is the structural root cause of event-loop starvation that caused node-cron to miss the 14:00 UTC and 15:30 UTC windows on 2026-05-19 and 2026-05-20. The 1958a fix (recoverMissedExecutions:true + startup catchup probes) mitigates the symptom. The architectural issue persists: startup operations should not consume the event loop for hours.
recommendation: Architect should evaluate: (1) moving OHLCV backfill to a background worker / separate thread; (2) rate-limiting the iterative HTTP calls during startup; (3) deferring heavy startup probes until after cron windows have passed (e.g., delay until 15:31 UTC).
